doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Band photograph, calliope tunes and the river trip
summary: A photograph of an Italian band at the cathedral, learning tunes from Fate Marable's calliope, and a train and river excursion across the lake.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
